question: edit video by transcript
response_text:
For a content creator in the US looking to edit video by transcript, the landscape has shifted significantly toward "text-based video editing." This approach allows you to edit your video as easily as editing a Word document—deleting text to cut video, rearranging sentences to reorder clips, and using AI to remove filler words.

Here are the best software tools, workflow methods, and industry leaders for transcript-based editing in 2024–2025.
